verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a shipping in-product AI layer, Ramp Intelligence. It attaches a policy-grounded recommended action to every spend request, scans transactions in real time for anomalies and fraud, auto-codes expenses, and fills memos and categories, so AI suggestions drawn from the customer's own data appear inside the product. Spend-trend and forecasting analysis is documented only through MCP in external assistants such as ChatGPT and Claude, so it is not credited as in-product. Missing for 10: documented in-product analytical insights (trends, forecasts) beyond per-item recommendations and flags; independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing.
